method: Local source tracing plus isolated tests; no production credentials or settings changed and no external model completion performed.
configurationFlow: draft -> verified -> active; personal active configuration takes priority over system active configuration, then deployment defaults. Existing revision snapshots can retain old settings.
verificationBoundary: LLM/embedding tests request GET /models; PDF requests API root; classroom requests /api/health. These do not prove generation, embeddings or parsing succeeds. Web search tests POST /v1/web-search.

providers.limits: Address/key/model are consumed by integrated paths. Independent classroom service models and some per-task timeout policies are separate.
Runtime values are read on client construction; backend protocol still comes from deployment. Existing vector indexes are not automatically rebuilt.

providers.uiChange: Read-only deployment notice; test/apply forms removed to avoid misleading success.

providers.limits: Bocha search/re-ranking reads runtime settings; course preparation ResearchSources and Tavily use deployment environment.
timeout_seconds only used for connectivity verification, not passed to MinerUCloudProvider.
model is not passed into OpenMaicConfig; actual model lives in classroom service. Removed unused model input from UI.

backendTests.isolation: dotenv loading disabled, no DATABASE_URL, temporary JSON stores; no business data writes.
